items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was that trumpet player named Steve Dunn? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. How did you happen to pick up on that?

ctx.x: Well, I've seen a picture of the band, and I remembered the names of the... I remember him because naturally I knew you and Jonesey, but I'd never heard anything about him...
You mentioned playing in a restaurant. But when would you start? You started in the afternoon and played...
